episodes.197343: Warm temperatures from a chinook event brought warmer temperatures to the Kenai Peninsula and mobilized ice on the Anchor River causing high water and flooding near near Anchor Point, AK.
episodes.198726: A slowing cold front interacted with deep tropical moisture on December 10th across southeast Louisiana and caused prolonged periods of heavy rainfall mainly across the city of Slidell. Significant street flooding occurred with this and cars became stranded in the typical problem spots across Slidell.

events.narrative: Warm temperatures caused snowmelt to raise river levels and dislodged ice cover on the Anchor River, from the Old Sterling Highway downstream to near Anchor Point.  Ice jammed at several locations along the river and caused flooding of parklands along the Anchor River and flooded areas of Anchor Point Road.  Road closures were monitored by DOT.
